grades: High school (also middle level and college chapters exist)
name: Illinois FBLA (Future Business Leaders of America)
what_you_do: Join a business club at your school. Members build leadership and business skills, compete in events, and network at local, state and national levels.
who_can_apply: Students at a school with an FBLA chapter. The page lists high school, middle level and college chapters. How to join is not explained on the program pages.
pay_detail: Dues are not stated on the program pages.
deadline_text: 2026-27 dates: State Leadership Conference Apr 9 to 10, 2027; Summer Leadership Experience Jul 29 to 31, 2027; National Leadership Conference Jun 23 to 26, 2027 in Columbus OH. Regional dates are in the calendar PDF.
how_to_apply: Ask a business teacher about a chapter at your school. The chapters page lists active chapters by region. Use the Contact page on ilfbla.org to ask how to join or start a chapter.
notes: Dues and how to start a chapter are not on the program pages. The national FBLA site blocked automated reading, so national rules were not checked.
